Lead 16 (~50 μs), same 105 validation starts. Early diffusion → new full-target diffusion → residual diffusion: density power ~25% → 90% → 104%. More power accompanies higher pointwise error. One sampled rollout per start; ensemble quality has not yet been established for the new pair. The target-heat closure is distinct from the radial energy transport plotted above.
Power by mode at selected fractions

Each field is divided by its own 100%-data reference error; lower is better. Gray strip is ±5%. At 25%, full-density RMSE matches the reference, while every fluctuation error remains above it. Fractions have categorical spacing; 25→100 is not a measured dense sweep.

Same 128 target frames, same native geometry, no 85606 fine-tuning. The shuffled parent changes its fitting data and fitted preprocessing. Density full-field error improves; the five fluctuation errors change by less than 1.5%. Integrated particle error increases 44.95% → 46.92%.
